name: covid
title: Outpatient Evaluation of COVID-19 Symptoms
description: Adult patient presents to primary care with COVID-19 symptoms confirmed by home rapid antigen test. Covers symptom assessment, risk stratification, Paxlovid eligibility evaluation, isolation guidance, and return-to-work counseling.
clinicalInvariants: Chief complaint: cough, fatigue, and low-grade fever for 4 days with positive home COVID test
Conditions: mild intermittent asthma (risk factor for severe COVID), seasonal allergies
Medications: albuterol PRN, cetirizine daily, acetaminophen for current illness
Vaccination status: up to date including bivalent booster ~8 months ago
Clinical findings: SpO2 97% on room air, temp 100.2F, lungs clear, mild pharyngeal erythema
Assessment: mild-moderate COVID-19 with asthma as risk factor for complications
Management: assess Paxlovid eligibility, symptomatic care, isolation guidance, return-to-work documentation, asthma action plan
Provider questions and SP responses remain substantively identical across all variants
